candidates.name: Sdffuglycompositionexample
candidates.observed: Almost uniform midgray with tiny specks.

source_review.finding: Source line 27 uses cellSize=0.015*scale (default 0.5), and lines 43-48 use a 0.025 cell grid with circle radius 0.00625. Probe pixels span 0.0104167 x 0.015625 UV: circle diameter is only 1.2 x 0.8 pixels. Tiny sparsely sampled features are expected; higher resolution is needed before judging this demo.

Source lines 308-311 samples psrdnoise over UV -1..1 with period vec3(mat_scale), where mat_scale defaults to 1 and alpha to 0. A short-period repeating lattice is consistent with source defaults; catalog noise scale is not established.

source_review_summary.method: Read original INPUTS, compare parameter defaults and uniform_vector values with the current adapter schema. No GPU calls. Runtime default bindings in the audit use uniform_vector(parameter, parameter.default).
source_review_summary.conclusion: No shared default-value mapping mismatch established in this shortlist. Several visual differences are directly explained by source defaults or geometry below probe pixel size; see source findings.
